name: [🧙‍♂️UPD 2] Drillbit and Co.
desc:
Drillbit and Co. is a sandbox tycoon game that encourages players to maximize profits through their own unique tycoon designs. As you earn more cash, you can buy better buildings, purchase more land, and hold more ore on your plot at one time.

📱💻🎮 You will be able to play on any device, on release. (MOBILE, PC, CONSOLE)

⭐ Please consider liking and favoriting the game for more updates.

👑 Premium Benefits
- Hard Hat Dropper
- Builder's Club Upgrader

🏝️ Private Server Benefits
- Tropical Cell Furnace

Development for this game began on 3/23/2025
